description: Call a capability whose contract you have from describeCapability. Pass `name` exactly as given — that is the handle; only when a result carries no `name` pass `method` and `path` instead. Arguments go in path_params / query / body under the spec's own names. One call makes one request and returns the product's response as sent; `select` narrows it only where the contract carries `narrowable`, and reports what it narrowed. When `completed` is false there is another page, fetched with the capability's own page parameter. If the mode is 'write' you MUST ask the user first, then resend with user_permission='granted' and a change_summary; both are recorded. Capabilities whose mode is 'destructive' are refused outright — archiving, closing and merging are ordinary writes and DO run, so read the mode and intent before confirming with the user.

body.description: Body fields, under the spec's names.

change_summary.description: What will change. Required for writes.

method.description: HTTP method — only for capabilities returned without a `name`.

name.description: The capability's published name, exactly as returned (e.g. 'create_test_run_by_integer_id'). Preferred over method/path.

path.description: Path with {placeholders} intact — only for capabilities returned without a `name`.

product.description: Which product owns the capability (app_accessibility, devicecontrol, loadtesting, mobiledevicecontrol, tm, tra, web_accessibility). searchCapability returns it on every result; required only when two products share a name or a path.

select.description: Only for a capability whose contract carries `narrowable`: narrows the response to those fields and reports what it narrowed.

distinct.description: Return one row per distinct combination of these fields and nothing else — the cheapest way to ask what values exist.

fields.description: Keep only these fields on each row.

where.description: Field -> the value it must take, or an array of accepted values. Strings match case-insensitively.

user_permission.description: Set to 'granted' only after the user has confirmed a write.

name: invokeCapability
